cls.quote: The Tern Vektron P5i, like many of the brand’s models, is a Class 1 e-bike with no throttle and a pedal assist system (PAS) limited to 20 mph. As such, the process of speed testing the bike was simple; I performed one pedal test on a flat, paved trail. As I rode, I monitored and noted my average speed in each PAS level to get a sense of the bike’s programming.

tq.quote: Powerful Bosch BES2 Performance motor provides up to 65 Nm of torque and 300% support ⟶ Intuitive, easy-to-read display keeps you informed and in control on the road

While we’re not able to compare apples to apples in either case, considering the performance of both of these groups can give us a valuable perspective on the Vektron. For a better picture of the Tern’s performance, the bike weighs roughly 54 lbs and its motor produces up to 600W and 65 Nm of torque.
